title: Scenario build prompt: the 'confirm first' line should also ask the build to lock the field a gated action changes
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1ZJL93Kin2UHFXbFv

Filing gate ②: the scope addition recorded on #34887 in 6966131652, split out on seat 4's ruling (2026-11-20 17:48Z, option A): its own card, not PR #35894. Dedupe: searched `scenario build prompt lock field gated action confirm first`; no open card. The skills card filed from the same maintainer answer covers the skill text, not the runner prompt.

Suggested-grade: p2. Without the lock, a card's build leaves the raw-door bypass of a confirmation gate open.

## What

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` has a "confirm first" line that asks the build to put a confirmation gate on an AI-gated action. It does not ask the build to stop the same field being written through a raw data door (`update_record`). An agent that meets `428 no_confirmation_service` can therefore write the target state directly. The maintainer's answers (「三个问题 同意」, 6966131652) say the confirmation gate is not widened to `update_record`, so the build has to close it with a field lock.

## Ask

Extend the "confirm first" line so that the build also locks, for the personas that run the gated action, the field or fields the gated action changes. Use the platform's field-level or state-machine mechanism that the skills teach. Check each scenario card first: the lock must not deny an `applied` operation that the card gives the same persona on that field. List any card where it would, and resolve each one in the card or in the prompt wording.

## Done when

- The prompt line asks for the lock.
- A dry-run of the build prompt shows it.
- The card audit above is recorded in the PR body.

Relations: from #34887 (6966131652). Shares the runner with #35894 and #34214. Lane: eval tooling (`packages/qa/scenarios`).
